channel.title: Edliss Notes
channel.description: Short notes about building simple, useful software and the ideas behind the apps Edliss makes.

item.title: The Cost of Trying to Be Helpful
item.description: Helpful software understands that attention is scarce, and knows when not to interrupt.

item.title: Simple Is Hard
item.description: Simple software is not small by default. It is software shaped by decisions.

item.title: Not Every App Needs an Account
item.description: Many useful apps work better when they ask less from the user.

item.title: Software Should Not Feel Like Administration
item.description: Good software should make the next useful action feel obvious.
